name: blinded
desc: Can't see; automatically fails ability checks that require sight. Attack rolls against it have advantage; its attack rolls have disadvantage.

name: charmed
desc: Can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful abilities; the charmer has advantage on social checks against it.

name: deafened
desc: Can't hear; automatically fails ability checks that require hearing.

name: frightened
desc: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight; can't willingly move closer to it.

name: grappled
desc: Speed becomes 0. Ends if the grappler is incapacitated or the grappled creature is moved out of reach.

name: invisible
desc: Impossible to see without magic; heavily obscured for hiding. Attack rolls against it have disadvantage; its attack rolls have advantage.

name: paralyzed
desc: Incapacitated; can't move or speak; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage and hit within 5 ft are critical hits.

name: petrified
desc: Transformed to stone; incapacitated; weight x10; resistance to all damage; immune to poison and disease; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage.

name: poisoned
desc: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: prone
desc: May only crawl; disadvantage on attack rolls; attacks against it have advantage within 5 ft and disadvantage beyond. Standing costs half speed.

name: restrained
desc: Speed 0; attacks against it have advantage; its attacks have disadvantage; disadvantage on DEX saves.

name: stunned
desc: Incapacitated; can't move; can speak only falteringly; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage.

name: unconscious
desc: Incapacitated; can't move or speak; unaware; drops what it holds and falls prone; auto-fails STR and DEX saves; attacks against it have advantage and hits within 5 ft are critical hits.

name: exhaustion
desc: Levels 1-6: 1 disadvantage on ability checks; 2 speed halved; 3 disadvantage on attacks and saves; 4 HP maximum halved; 5 speed 0; 6 death.

name: turned
desc: (Turn Undead) Must spend turns moving away from the cleric; can't take reactions; can only Dash or try to escape; ends after 1 minute or on taking damage.

name: hidden
desc: (engine) Unseen by enemies after a successful Hide; attacks from hiding have advantage and attacks against it disadvantage. Revealed on attacking or casting.

name: faerie_fire
desc: (engine) Outlined in light: attack rolls against it have advantage and it cannot benefit from being invisible.
